title: Former spouse living.
bodyText: A marriage may be declared null on the ground that one of the parties has an undivorced spouse living, on the application of either of the parties during the lifetime of the other, or on the application of the former spouse.
bodyHtml: §580-23  Former spouse living.  A marriage may be declared null on the ground that one of the parties has an undivorced spouse living, on the application of either of the parties during the lifetime of the other, or on the application of the former spouse. [CC 1859, §1315; RL 1925, §2957; RL 1935, §4452; RL 1945, §12203; RL 1955, §324-3; HRS §580-23; am L 2023, c 160, §9]
